name: Omnitex Industries (India) Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1987, Omnitex Industries  (India) Ltd is engaged in trading of fabrics  and yarn[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
OIIL used to be in a joint venture with 
a foreign partner in the field of technical 
 textiles and infrastructure development. 
 Later, it disposed of its land and building 
at Silvassa and stopped its manufacturing activities. Currently, it trades fabrics 
 and yarn

cons: Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -22.2%
Company has a low return on equity of 11.9% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.94 Cr.
